rows.grounds: points to the hidden true nature as the object of knowledge
expresses the prior act of knowing that leads to the result
compound denoting a concealed essential reality; object of knowing

items.question: What state arises from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: A hidden true nature exists as an object of knowledge.
That hidden true nature can be directly known.
Knowing it produces a transformative result.
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature gives rise to omniscience.
uncertainties: The antecedent of taṃ may refer to a specific reality described in the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, omniscience arises.
